message.content: The exhaustive GPU probe checked all 2^32 uint32 values: 6554 mismatch chunks beginning at ~2^31.5; e.g. index 3435973841 produced row 490853406 (should be 490853405), and col 4294967295 (should be 6) — a clear off-by-one in the fixed-point quotient causing a negative remainder stored as huge uint32. This violates the exact-division contract. I'll record the evidence and reject.
